findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The method concatenates user input into a dynamic SOQL string without using bind variables, risking SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or Database.queryWithBinds to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The method does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, potentially allowing access to data the user should not see.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce CRUD and FLS permissions on the query results.

findings.title: SOQL Injection
findings.explanation: The searchKey parameter is concatenated directly into a dynamic SOQL query string, which can lead to SOQL injection.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely include user input in SOQL queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, potentially allowing access to fields or records the user should not see.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS permissions.

findings.title: SOSL Injection
findings.explanation: User input is concatenated into a SOSL search term, allowing an attacker to inject malicious input.
findings.remediation: Use bind variables or String.escapeSingleQuotes to safely include user input in dynamic queries.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The SOQL query does not enforce CRUD/FLS using WITH USER_MODE or WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce CRUD/FLS.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The DML statement does not enforce CRUD/FLS using 'update as user'.
findings.remediation: Change 'update amendment' to 'update as user amendment' to enforce CRUD/FLS.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The SOQL query does not use WITH USER_MODE, so it ignores object and field permissions.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The DML operation does not use 'update as user', so it ignores object and field permissions.
findings.remediation: Use 'update as user' for the DML operation to enforce CRUD and FLS.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query runs in system mode, ignoring field-level security, and updates the Rating field without enforcing FLS.
findings.remediation: Use WITH USER_MODE in the SOQL query and enforce FLS using Security.stripInaccessible before updating the Rating field.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants access to the AccountRatingService class, which allows editing the Rating field even though AnnualRevenue is hidden from this role.
findings.remediation: Remove the class access or ensure the permission set aligns with the least privilege principle.

findings.title: FLS violation
findings.explanation: The code does not check if the user has create permission on Task before inserting it.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce FLS on the Task object before inserting.

findings.title: CRUD violation
findings.explanation: The code does not check if the user has create permission on Task before inserting it.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce CRUD on the Task object before inserting.

findings.title: Excessive permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants edit and read permissions on Case, which may be more than necessary for escalating cases.
findings.remediation: Review and restrict the permissions to only what is necessary for escalating cases.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The query in getAllAccountsForSync() does not enforce CRUD and FLS permissions, as it runs in system mode without WITH USER_MODE.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS permissions.

findings.title: Sharing Violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared without sharing, which ignores record-level sharing rules. This could allow access to records the user should not see.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'public with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Sharing mode violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which ignores record-level sharing rules. This can lead to unauthorized access to Case records.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.lines: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Description FROM Case
findings.explanation: The SOQL query does not enforce CRUD and FLS checks. This can lead to unauthorized access to Case fields.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce CRUD and FLS checks.

findings.title: Sharing violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which means it ignores record-level sharing rules. This allows partner community users to see opportunities from all accounts, not just their own.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Excessive permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants access to the FinancialDashboardController class, which runs in system context and ignores sharing rules. This allows partner community users to see more data than intended.
findings.remediation: Ensure the class is 'with sharing' or enforce USER_MODE to respect record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Sharing violation
findings.explanation: DataAggregator is declared 'without sharing', ignoring record-level sharing rules. This class is reachable from @AuraEnabled, making it accessible to external users who can bypass sharing rules.
findings.remediation: Change the sharing mode of DataAggregator to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Excessive permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants access to DataAggregator, which is declared 'without sharing'. This allows users to bypass sharing rules, potentially exposing sensitive data.
findings.remediation: Ensure that DataAggregator is 'with sharing' before granting access through the permission set.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants Modify All Data and View All Data, which are powerful system permissions that should only be granted to administrators or integration users with a clear need.
findings.remediation: Remove Modify All Data and View All Data from the permission set unless absolutely necessary and justified.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS Violation
findings.explanation: The 'update as user' statement does not enforce field-level security (FLS) for the Status__c field.
findings.remediation: Use Security.stripInaccessible to enforce FLS before updating the record.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants 'ManageInternalUsers', which is not related to the purpose of reviewing and approving invoices.
findings.remediation: Remove the 'ManageInternalUsers' permission from the permission set.

findings.title: Excessive Permissions
findings.explanation: The permission set grants 'ViewAllData' which is a powerful system permission that should only be granted to administrators or integration users with a clear need.
findings.remediation: Remove 'ViewAllData' from the permission set unless absolutely necessary and justified.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The guest user profile grants access to the PublicCatalogController class, which can be called by anyone on the internet through the site's Aura endpoint.
findings.remediation: Remove the PublicCatalogController class from the guest user profile's classAccesses, or ensure it only returns data intended to be public and enforces USER_MODE.

findings.title: CRUD/FLS violation
findings.explanation: The query in getActiveProducts does not enforce field-level security (FLS) for the Product2 object.
findings.remediation: Use WITH SECURITY_ENFORCED in the SOQL query to enforce FLS.

findings.title: Sharing mode violation
findings.explanation: The class is declared 'without sharing', which ignores record-level sharing rules. This allows guest users to access Contact records they should not see.
findings.remediation: Change the class declaration to 'with sharing' to enforce record-level sharing rules.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The ContactSearchController class is accessible to the guest user profile, allowing unauthenticated users to query Contact records.
findings.remediation: Remove ContactSearchController from the classAccesses for the guest user profile or ensure the class enforces proper sharing rules.

findings.title: Guest user exposure
findings.explanation: The guest profile grants access to the KnowledgeSearchController class, which can be called by unauthenticated users through the site's Aura endpoint.
findings.remediation: Remove the class access for KnowledgeSearchController from the guest profile, or ensure the class enforces strict sharing and data access rules.

findings.title: Sharing not enforced
findings.explanation: The KnowledgeSearchController class is marked 'with sharing', but it does not enforce record-level sharing for the KnowledgeArticleVersion query.
findings.remediation: Add WITH USER_MODE to the SOQL query to enforce record-level sharing.
